E0511

`Expiring.force` bypasses fallible cache-expiry access — use `get(clock)`

What

`Expiring.force` bypasses fallible cache-expiry access — use `get(clock)`

Why

An expiring value can be past its time, so it is read through `get(clock)`, which reports the expiry

Fix

Use fallible `Expiring.get(clock)` instead of `Expiring.force`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0511: tests/ui/expiring_force_unwrap.stderr.

Error [jet.ExpiringForce]: `ExpiringValue.force` bypasses expiry checking
  --> tests/ui/expiring_force_unwrap.jet:11:13
    |
 11 |     _: item.force(clk)
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: TTL-wrapped values must use fallible `get(clock)` so expired access is handled explicitly
 Fix: Use `.get(clock)` and handle `Expired`
